title: Lando Calrissian
description: LANDO CALRISSIAN goes from amoral scoundrel to general in the Rebel forces. By the time of the Ewok party that ends RETURN OF THE JEDl, he is envisioned wearing (front) a tailored outfit with vest to ward off the forest chill. Lando also disguises himself as a skill guard (back) to infiltrate Jabba the Hutt's crew and help Luke rescue Leia and Han from the clutches of the galactic gangster. Sketches by Nilo Rodis-Jamero.
